program.section_heading: Computer Applications Specialist Associate of Arts (AA) Degree
outcomes: Create a personal or business website containing hyperlinks, marquee, graphic hotspots, and tables.
Create and format a presentation with transitions, custom animations, graphics, video, and audio, using Microsoft PowerPoint.
Produce a business style report using a computer and Microsoft Word.
Type a business letter and an envelope from unformatted copy in the Block Style Letter format within 25 minutes time using Microsoft Word.
Utilize the Windows Security Center to protect a computer against computer security risks.

notes: Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (CAOT 001 etc.); these match closed-list codes CAOT 1, CAOT 2, CAOT 14, etc.
degree_total of 60 taken from the award header 'Total Units: Minimum of 60'; no general education pattern or GE units are named in this section.
Career entry taken from 'qualify for intermediate office positions'; description also mentions employment in business, government, and educational offices.
